sections.heading: Can Online GeM Registration Help You Sell Big? Here’s How to Get Started Fast!
paragraphs: Online GeM Registration is your first step towards giving your business access to a world of fantastic business opportunities when you would like to sell your products or services directly to government departments in India. Government e-Marketplace, popularly referred to as GeM, is India's shopping destination for procurement by government departments. Thus, with your registration as a seller, manufacturer, and service provider, you can open up your products and services to thousands of government-buying agencies.

This blog will guide you through what Online GeM Registration is, what it entails in terms of eligibility, types of sellers, key advantages to be enjoyed, required documentation and the detailed process of becoming a GeM seller. This is your roadmap to being a GeM seller if you are an MSME, startup, or an established company.

Online GeM Registration means enrolling your business as a seller or service provider on the Government e-Marketplace portal (gem.gov.in). GeM was introduced in the year 2016 by the Government of India with the idea of making public procurement transparent, efficient, and, above all, paperless.
On completing gem seller registration online, you can list products, bid, and supply to the central and state government buyers along with PSUs and autonomous bodies.
Eligibility criteria for Online GeM Registration are wide-ranging business types covering
If you meet any of these categories, you can commence the gem seller registration process and start selling to the government.
